summary: Per-frame tire temperature update with a thermal model. Computes two tire-temperature updates from absolute slip inputs, friction-heating and convection coefficients, blending toward an ambient reference derived from flt_8AFEF0 + 273.16; then runs a four-iteration normalization loop that clamps each corner temperature into [0, 1] and stores it through a wheel base pointer at this+0x8CC. Called per frame by MainGameTickUpdate (0042C690).

local_names.this: wheel object (float array; offsets are byte displacements)
local_names.a2: frame-delta time scale applied to the thermal rate terms
local_names.v3: per-corner wheel base pointer (this + 563 floats, i.e. byte offset 0x8CC)
local_names.v4: running pointer over the four corner temperature slots starting at this+0x35DC

operations.description: Compute the ambient reference v17 = flt_8AFEF0 + 273.16 used as the convective target temperature.
Read the shared absolute slip-magnitude term v16 = fabs(this+0x3500) used by both temperature updates.

First temperature update: new_temp = ((fabs(slip_a)*coef_a + fabs(slip_b)*coef_b) * convection * 0.5 + (v16 * friction + convection_off) * (v17 - temp)) * a2 + temp, using slip/coefficient inputs at this+0x35B0/+0x35D8 and this+0x36A8/+0x36D0 with model parameters this+0x3A38/+0x3A3C/+0x3A40; written to this+0x35DC and copied to this+0x36D4.

Second temperature update: same form against temperature slot this+0x37CC using slip/coefficient inputs at this+0x37A0/+0x37C8 and this+0x3898/+0x38C0 with model parameters this+0x3A4C/+0x3A50/+0x3A54; written to this+0x37CC and copied to this+0x38C4.

Four-iteration normalization loop: for each of the four corner temperatures (read at this+0x35DC, this+0x36D4, this+0x37CC, this+0x38C4, stepping 62 floats), normalize value = ((temp - 1023.16) * 0.004) clamped into [0, 1] and write it to the per-corner slot reached through the wheel base pointer at this+0x8CC (stepping 74 floats per corner).
Invoked per frame by MainGameTickUpdate (0042C690) as the tire-temperature stage of the game tick.
